name: idJagTokenExchange
description: On MCP tools/call, exchanges the user's ID token (kept by the gateway at sign-in, or sent in a header) for an ID-JAG at the IdP, redeems it at the upstream's authorization server, and sends the upstream token instead of the gateway token. Optionally answers the MCP server's resource metadata, so clients sign in through the gateway. Runs the IdJagTokenMediator class from code/apim-idjag-policy.

policyAttributes.name: idpTokenEndpoint
policyAttributes.description: WSO2 IS token endpoint (step 1: ID token to ID-JAG)

policyAttributes.name: idpClientId
policyAttributes.description: The gateway's client at the IdP

policyAttributes.name: idpClientSecret
policyAttributes.description: The gateway's secret at the IdP

policyAttributes.name: audience
policyAttributes.description: Identifier of the upstream's authorization server; becomes the ID-JAG's aud

policyAttributes.name: resourceAsTokenEndpoint
policyAttributes.description: The upstream authorization server's token endpoint (step 2: ID-JAG to access token)

policyAttributes.name: resourceAsClientId
policyAttributes.description: The gateway's client at the upstream authorization server; same ID as at the IdP

policyAttributes.name: resourceAsClientSecret
policyAttributes.description: The gateway's secret at the upstream authorization server

policyAttributes.name: resourceAsScopes
policyAttributes.description: Optional scope for step 2; must be within the ID-JAG's

policyAttributes.name: idTokenHeader
policyAttributes.description: Optional inbound header with the user's ID token; must name the authenticated user. Without it, the ID token kept at sign-in is used

policyAttributes.name: tlsInsecureSkipVerify
policyAttributes.description: Local development only. Import the IdP's certificate into the gateway trust store instead

policyAttributes.name: authorizationServer
policyAttributes.description: When set, the gateway answers the MCP server's resource metadata itself, naming this sign-in server (the gateway's /idp address for the IdP). Empty: APIM answers

policyAttributes.name: scopesSupported
policyAttributes.description: scopes_supported in that resource metadata: openid plus the MCP tools' scopes
